absorb.line: He drank until she was so absorbing
stanza: She was like nothing that he’d seen before
Strong body, soft edges, with something so raw
In the core of her iris
He said his name, ‘Harry’
And never in his life had he felt so happy
They got talking
Free bar. Exhausting decorum
He drank until she was so absorbing
He blanked out the party
The floor spun, he stared at her face and felt sure
Something was happening here

absorb.line: Full of people all absorbed in their own personal catastrophes

Full of people all absorbed in their own personal catastrophes
All reading books like Being Mortal, all with a look in their eyes

"No, my devastation is unique"

stanza: The second time I went to Haida Gwaii was just me and our daughter
Only one month after you died, my face was still contorted

I needed to return to the place where we discovered that childless, we could bl…

But then I remember death is real
And I'm still here in Masset, it's August 12th, 2016

There is sand still in the blankets from the beach where we released you from t…
